The Magnusson TX long arm key set is designed for secure fastening and unfastening of TX head screws and bolts. The professional-grade tool collection is constructed from robust chrome vanadium steel, with each long arm key offering exceptional durability and resistance to rust, ensuring a prolonged service life in demanding work environments. The extended shaft provides improved access into confined spaces and delivers optimal leverage on screws and bolts, making it ideal for automotive technicians working on engine components or electricians installing fixtures in tight enclosures. The comprehensive 9-piece set includes common sizes from T8 to T45, and is supplied in a convenient tool holder for efficient storage and transport on various job sites.
